notes: Prerelease 3.0.0-beta.3 is a test version of Printer Bot 3.0 and it can have mistakes. It needs no new import. A new setting, Printers per browser, says how many printers each hidden Edge browser serves, from 1 to 100. The default of 100 keeps one browser for all printers, as before, and Printer Bot never starts more than 16. Hype Train receipts always use the first browser. Reload the dock after the update.
